gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8427 covers fork-lift trucks; Section XVI note/Chapter 84 checked, no exclusion
GRI 2(a): an unfinished forklift that has the essential character of the complete truck (chassis, engine, drivetrain, operator station) is classified as the finished truck

GRI 6: 8427.20 other self-propelled trucks (not electric motor powered, since propulsion is an LPG internal combustion engine); 8427.20.40 rider-type counterbalanced fork-lift trucks, the standard IC-engine LPG forklift configuration

other self-propelled works trucks; applies only if the truck is not a rider-type counterbalanced forklift

missing_facts: Which components are missing at importation (confirms the essential character under GRI 2(a))
Whether the trucks are rider-type counterbalanced (vs. other configurations)
classification.rationale: Under GRI 2(a), an unfinished forklift that already has its chassis, LPG internal combustion engine and drivetrain has the essential character of a complete fork-lift truck of heading 8427. Because it is propelled by an internal combustion engine rather than an electric motor, it falls in 8427.20. LPG forklifts are normally rider-type counterbalanced, which gives 8427.20.40.00. NY N329057 (in force) shows the parallel treatment of a seated electric forklift in 8427.10.40, the electric-motor counterpart.
